Apple Home Hardware: HomeView Hub & The LG/Schneider Teardown

Thermal throttling, Thread mesh networking, and custom power delivery in smart home controllers.

1. Thermal Constraints in Wall-Mounted Smart Displays

Enclosing high-performance silicon inside a sealed in-wall enclosure introduces extreme thermal bottlenecks. Without convective airflow, heat dissipation relies strictly on conductive thermal mass spreaders and perimeter passive radiation.

By utilizing structural die-cast aluminum chassis plates bonded with high-performance phase-change thermal interface materials (TIM), surface temperatures remain safely below touch thresholds while preventing processor thermal throttling under continuous 1080p camera decoding.
